title: LCARdS Alert Overlay
description: Full-screen alert overlay card that reacts to the lcards_alert_mode input_select

dismiss_mode.description: dismiss = hide overlay only; reset = hide + set alert_mode back to green_alert; auto-dismiss = automatically hide after auto_dismiss_seconds; auto-reset = automatically hide and reset alert_mode after auto_dismiss_seconds

auto_dismiss_seconds.description: Seconds before the overlay auto-dismisses. Required when dismiss_mode is auto-dismiss or auto-reset. Can be overridden per condition under conditions.<key>.auto_dismiss_seconds.

backdrop.description: [DEPRECATED] Migrated at runtime to layers.backdrop + layers.color. Still accepted for backward compatibility.

oneOf.description: null: explicitly disables all screen effect layers (useful as a per-condition override).
Screen effect layers applied independently behind the overlay. Absent slot = disabled; null slot = explicitly cleared.
Explicitly disable this layer for a condition override
CSS backdrop-filter layer. Preset: blur | grayscale | saturate | contrast | hue-rotate
Explicitly disable this layer for a condition override
Colour overlay layer. Preset: color-tint | vignette
Explicitly disable this layer for a condition override
Canvas animation layer. Preset: static | pixelate | glitch | scanlines

display.description: overlay = backdrop and the alert symbol (or content card) in the middle, the dashboard blocked until dismissed; band = a row of dashes across the screen with the symbol in the middle, the dashboard stays usable (click the symbol to dismiss)

band.description: Alert band settings (display: band). A row of dashes in the condition colour across the screen, with the alert symbol in the middle.

position.description: Where the band sits: top, center, bottom, or a percentage of the screen height for the band centre (e.g. 75%)

dash_radius.description: Dash corner radius in px, or pill for fully rounded ends

grow.description: Peak dash height as a multiple of the band height, following the animation: the dashes swell as the sweep passes (or all together with flash). 1 = no growth

emblem.description: Show the alert symbol (or the content card) in the middle of the band. Without it, only auto-dismiss or the alert mode changing hides the band

emblem_scale.description: Height of the symbol as a multiple of the band height

animation.description: sweep = a flash runs outward from the symbol; flash = all dashes pulse together; none = still. Reduced-motion settings turn it off

direction.description: Sweep direction: outward from the symbol, or inward from the screen edges

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (2 = twice as fast). The alert symbol bars follow it unless alert_button.speed is set

color.description: Dash colour (default: the condition alert colour from the theme)

width.description: Content card width (CSS value). Percentages are of the screen. Default 60%.

height.description: Content card height (CSS value). Percentages are of the screen. Default: 50% for the built-in alert symbol when no width is set either; otherwise the content sizes itself (auto).

conditions.description: Per-condition overrides. Keys match alert mode values (red_alert, yellow_alert, etc.)

content.description: HA card config to render inside the overlay for this condition

alert_button.description: Patch merged on top of the default lcards-button alert card for this condition. Only specify fields to override: type, component, and preset are inherited from the built-in default. Supports all lcards-button text and alert config keys. Ignored when `content` is also specified (content takes full precedence).

text.description: Text field overrides: e.g. text.sub_text.content or text.alert_text.content

alert.description: Alert component config overrides: e.g. alert.color.shape, alert.color.bars

speed.description: Speed multiplier for the alert symbol bar sweep (2 = twice as fast). In band mode it follows band.speed unless set

backdrop.description: [DEPRECATED] Migrated at runtime to layers. Still accepted for backward compatibility.

layers.description: Per-condition screen effect layer overrides. Unset slots inherit from the global layers config. null = explicitly disable that slot.

display.description: Presentation for this condition (overlay or band); falls back to the card display

band.description: Band settings for this condition, merged over the card band

position.description: Where the band sits: top, center, bottom, or a percentage of the screen height for the band centre (e.g. 75%)

dash_radius.description: Dash corner radius in px, or pill for fully rounded ends

grow.description: Peak dash height as a multiple of the band height, following the animation: the dashes swell as the sweep passes (or all together with flash). 1 = no growth

emblem.description: Show the alert symbol (or the content card) in the middle of the band. Without it, only auto-dismiss or the alert mode changing hides the band

emblem_scale.description: Height of the symbol as a multiple of the band height

animation.description: sweep = a flash runs outward from the symbol; flash = all dashes pulse together; none = still. Reduced-motion settings turn it off

direction.description: Sweep direction: outward from the symbol, or inward from the screen edges

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (2 = twice as fast). The alert symbol bars follow it unless alert_button.speed is set

color.description: Dash colour (default: the condition alert colour from the theme)

width.description: Content card width for this condition (CSS value); falls back to the card width

height.description: Content card height for this condition (CSS value); falls back to the card height

auto_dismiss_seconds.description: Override auto-dismiss duration for this specific condition. Only relevant when the global dismiss_mode is auto-dismiss or auto-reset.

lcards_alert_overlay_band_phase.description: Lock the band animation to the alert symbol bar sweep, this many degrees later (the symbol innermost bars light at 150, so 180 makes an outward sweep carry on out of the symbol). Unset = not locked. Needs the symbol and the same speed for both
